title: Review of thermodynamic structures and structure-preserving discretisations of Cahn--Hilliard-type models
summary: The Cahn-Hilliard equation and extensions, notably the Cahn-Hilliard-Darcy and Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes systems, provide widely used frameworks for coupling interfacial thermodynamics with flow. This review surveys the thermodynamic structures underlying these models, focusing on the formulation of free energy functionals, dissipation mechanisms, and variational principles. We compare structural properties, emphasizing how these models encode conservation laws and energy dissipation.
